title: A Portrait for the Visitor
author: August Dunmore
blurb: Rafael Kavanagh, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
